claims.statement: The 2208-call prepared BGRA-to-FP32 handoff observations are warm component evidence: vImage often beats the source-bound loop but loses to the compiled GPU control. They do not qualify actual CVPixelBuffer/texture lifetime, decode/color/resize/VAE/codec requests, cold/peak/long-run or inter-frame overlap; historical per-trial oracle minima are not a deployable policy.

The pinned MLX Copy::eval source and four local adoption protocols treat same-dtype Copy as an alias, not an independent snapshot. This is a version-bound source/observation claim, not a GPU/ANE or model qualification.

The 560-call five-arm warm layer0 FFN observations and 264 exact actual-part joins remain component evidence, not full-request, LoRA, cold-memory or physical-overlap qualification; setup and the first-run opposite-direction copy/shared observation remain in the capsule.

The recorded 330 ordinary-block calls and 198 exact joins preceded raw/archive reserve refusals. All protocols remain failed with null comparisons; no qualified ratio, complete candidate request or real-model archive decode was delivered.
